_game: SuperTuxKart (sports/racing): Cornfield Crossing (track cornfield_crossing, 1264 m per lap) -- the current game, via its own gym server
_note: pip install 'fmri-gym[stk]' (or supertuxkart-gym): the wheel fetches the game and a 270 MiB asset pack from its GitHub release on first use, Linux x86_64 only -- no checkout and no build, and STK_ENV_BIN overrides the binary it fetched. Needs a real OpenGL display: the game renders into a hidden window and every frame is read back and shown here; it does not work under SDL_VIDEODRIVER=dummy or with --render-driver=vulkan.
_track_note: One config per race track the asset pack ships with geometry: hacienda, cornfield_crossing, lighthouse, scotland, snowmountain. Its other track directories (abyss, mines, zengarden, ... and the battle arenas and soccer fields) are metadata only -- naming one kills the game process -- so a new track means a pack that carries it, not a new config. The track is fixed for the life of a process, so a curriculum races several by using one game phase per track.
_keys_note: The env's action is MultiBinary(8) over SuperTuxKart's keys, so 'keys' values are indices: 0=left, 1=right, 2=up (accelerate), 3=down (brake / reverse), 4=nitro, 5=skid, 6=fire, 7=rescue; held keys combine and the game's own player controller turns them into controls. The map below is SuperTuxKart's default bindings; keep the Controls text in sync by hand.
_timing_note: The game is lock-stepped: one step per frame, frame_skip physics ticks (120 Hz) per step, so fps must equal 120 / frame_skip; the adapter refuses otherwise. Measured 2.5 ms per step at 640x360 with four karts on an Intel Arc laptop.
_logging_note: Per frame: actions (the 8-vector), reward (progress, metres), and every SAMPLE_FIELDS column from stk_gym: tick/time/phase, speed, x/y/z, heading, distance_down_track, distance_to_center, on_road/on_ground/wrong_way, rank, finished_laps, powerup, nitro_energy, progress_m, ctrl_* (the controls the kart applied). Frames are shown, not stored. A block replays from episode_seeds + actions with the same track, karts, seed and supertuxkart-gym version: step a fresh stk_gym.StkEnv through the logged actions.
